description: e2000fs_feat30_lognormal_crps. Direct LightGBM lognormal (mu, rho) per horizon trained by closed-form CRPS; point forecast is the predictive mean. Frozen HPO; no official-based selection. Inherited Top30 features were selected using previously scored official periods; post-hoc official-exposed research, not a fresh holdout. Targets mature 72h before cutoff; F1 cutoff 2026-02-26, F2 cutoff 2026-05-29. ACE lag 0, causal forward fill. Published script replays hash-pinned forecasts; training source archived. Uploaded on 2026-10-29 at user request for complete leaderboard reporting; no settings changed after the run. Inference timing: saved CPU models, two threads, median of 3 batches of 32 real query origins; excludes distribution/histogram decoding, feature assembly, loading and I/O.

data.feature_set: e2000fs_dirmo_24_feat30 Top30 (21 constant + 24h x 9 varying per block)
data.prefill: causal forward fill; leading missing retained

frozen_run_manifest.comparisons: internal paired low MSE versus L2 and high MSE versus extreme L2; historical XGBoost reference separate
frozen_run_manifest.controls: unweighted L2 and factor4 block-event-weighted L2, both same frozen HPO
frozen_run_manifest.distribution_contract: continuous lognormal marginal per horizon; not a 72h joint distribution

hpo.policy: minimum internal MSE among currently COMPLETE trials; immutable snapshot, not final HPO winner

tailcal_crps.note: smooth batch CDF calibration adaptation, not exact paper TMCB

parent.output_strategy: independent horizon models; shared block inputs

frozen_run_manifest.point_forecast: lognormal predictive mean, clipped to the common [1,3000] contract; raw mean also retained
frozen_run_manifest.publication: local evaluation only; no upload or parent promotion
frozen_run_manifest.selection: all fixed arms frozen here; no official-based candidate or hyperparameter selection
frozen_run_manifest.target: absolute positive ACE speed km/s; no residual addition

hyperparameters.selection: frozen original run; no official-score tuning; user-requested reporting upload
